# Rule: Pointer parameter gained restrict

_Canonical rule slug:_ `pointer-parameter-gained-restrict`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A published pointer parameter gains `restrict`, tightening the caller's aliasing obligation without changing the calling convention -- overlapping arguments that were legal become undefined.
